name: o61646

items.description: Bundle ID to VPN UUID mapping

VPNUUID.description: The VPNUUID of the Per-App VPN defined in a Per-App VPN payload.

PayloadIdentifier.description: A unique identifier for the payload, dot-delimited.  Usually root PayloadIdentifier+subidentifier

PayloadOrganization.description: This value describes the issuing organization of the profile, as displayed to the user

PayloadType.description: The type of the payload, a reverse dns string

PayloadVersion.description: The version of the whole configuration profile.

description:
The configuration we are deploying is a Per‑App VPN Payload, described simply as “Per‑App VPN Payload” and presented to users under the same display name. It is identified in our profile hierarchy as **com.example.profile.vpnappmapping**, issued by **Example Corp**, and is of type **com.apple.vpn.managed.appmapping**. The unique identifier assigned to this payload is **A1B2C3D4-5678-90AB-CDEF-1234567890AB**, and it is currently version 1.

This payload maps two specific applications to their dedicated VPN tunnels. The first mapping links the app with bundle identifier **com.example.app1** to the VPN UUID **123E4567-E89B-12D3-A456-426614174000**. The second mapping connects **com.example.app2** to the VPN UUID **987F6543-21AB-34CD-56EF-7890ABCDEF12**. These associations ensure that traffic from each app is routed through its appropriate VPN connection as defined in the profile.
